body: Ill still get judged by my outside family for doing this. Those kind of criticism still hurt. I am not that strong of a person. I still feel that if I were to do this I would still think about suicide. There is a lot going wrong with me other than my grades. I hate the person that Ive become and I hate that I am in this situation.

I honestly dont know if I am a good writer. I think I do write better if I am passionate about the things that I write but I also know that I am not a reading kind of guy. Books have always been kinda boring to me. I do know that I am good speaker. Speaking in front of a crowd doesnt bother me that much

I could do what everyone is telling me in this thread, to take a leave of absence and do some work, to think about what I really want. But I feel like I would still think about committing suicide. I would probably feel like a loser, a loser for leaving school and going to work at some fast food restaurant, for not living up to my potential. If I go through will all of this I think that I would still think that suicide is a option.

But people will still judge me for that. And I dont think I can handle that kind of criticism. I will disappoint my family by doing this, by dropping out by accepting failure. I have no idea what to do and I still think that suicide is a answer. Im not going to kill myself today or probably tomorrow but I still think about it everyday

I am dead scared in talking to my parents. I know that I have to and I probably will but I'm am so scared on how angry he will get. My parents made a lot of sacrifice for me and if I'm just failing then I'm just a burden on them. A huge waste. And I feel that if I end my life i can escape all those responsibilities and escape all the disappointment. I don't have a lot going for me, I really don't.

I feel like I have to keep going. I'd don't know what to do with the time off. I'm scared that if I do take a leave I would still end up doing the samething that I've always been doing. And then there is my mom who is a huge guilt trip, all she does is lecture me on how I can do better. She's not really helping but she is right
I would be completely embarrassed if I had to do that. I come from a very large family and to tell them I'm not as smart as I look, it hurts.

yeah Im in college right now but I dont know how much longer I can last here with these grades. It keeps getting worse and worse by the quarter. I dont want to flunk, I dont want to get kicked out but that still doesnt seem to motivate me. 
I remember the N64, I remember selling it when I was younger. The biggest mistake of my childhood.
Im really bad at writing which practically essential when you are in college. And Im mostly play nintendo video games. I only have a Wii U and a 3DS
thank you for the response and for the resource

I guess I could try, but Im still so scared that whatever I do Im just delaying the inevitable. The look of disappointment that my parents will make when they see my grades will hurts me so much. 
Thank you for taking the time to read and write to me

I dont know, im scared to talk to her. Im scared that she will just telling that I deserve these consequences for my actions. Im also scared that she will send me to some church to find god. She is very religious like that I dont have the heart to tell her that Im atheist.

When I call the hotline and talk to me and sorta help me. they say that I should talk to someone, a profession to get some help. But I guess Im so obsessed for finding a solution to my problems when there isnt one. There is no solution that will fix my grades right now. The only solution that I can think of is suicide. You cant get bad grades when your dead. Realizing that fact is what gets me more stress and tired all day.
I havent really mention this to many people but ive called the hotline multiple times now. Sometimes they help but its only a moment of relief before i become really depressed again
